notes: Gold triage conversations, set B (areas: mold_damp, pests, roof_ceiling_leak, intercom, lift, management, other; plus vague-area, two-problem and emergency routing). Same schema and rules as set A: question ids, answer keys, cause ids and tenant_message texts come from the area KBs; tenant_facts holds the answer the tenant gives when first asked; for self_help_fails the KB's if_fails answers of the self-help cause override them after the failed tip, which yields expected_cause. Technician causes: concluding message, then the consent question (', floor and the photos' only when a photo was sent), then 'Thanks. Your property manager is confirming the repair, I'll update you shortly.' A re-ask after an off-topic reply repeats the same qid and does not count twice; 'clarify' does not count. Emergencies (fire or smoke but not 'smoke alarm', a CO alarm, someone stuck in the lift) come from the words: the safety message first, no question, no consent. vague_area: a first message with no area keyword gets 'Ok. What is it about?' ('Okay. Worum geht es?'), marked asks='area'; it is not a diagnostic question and the tenant's next turn names the area. two_problems: expected_area/expected_cause/expected_outcome/expected_trade and tenant_facts are the first-diagnosed problem (the first mentioned; an area with its own KB before hot water or heating); second_area, second_cause and second_tenant_facts are the queued one (second_area no_hot_water is the hot-water KB). Once the first is settled (tip confirmed, caretaker or management told, or consent answered) Debye sends 'Now to {label}.' ('Jetzt kümmere ich mich um {label_de}.') as its own message and the second diagnosis starts; max_diagnostic_questions applies to each problem. Water through the ceiling is not the flooding emergency (the router leaves it to the ceiling KB), even when it pours. management: at most 1 question.

conversations.title: Kleine trockene Schimmelflecken am Fenster (deutsch)

turns.text: Hallo, im Schlafzimmer am Fenster sind ein paar kleine trockene Schimmelflecken, kleiner als meine Hand.

Kleine trockene Flecken kommen meist von Kondenswasser. Wisch sie mit Schimmelentferner oder 70-%-Alkohol ab (Handschuhe, Fenster auf), lüfte 3-4 Mal am Tag 5-10 Minuten stoß und lass eine Handbreit Abstand zwischen Möbeln und Außenwänden. Sag mir, ob er wiederkommt.
Hab sie abgewischt und lüfte jetzt öfter, die Flecken sind weg.
Schön. Melde dich jederzeit, wenn er wiederkommt.

conversations.title: Mould in the bedroom corner comes back bigger after cleaning

turns.text: there's black mould in the corner of my bedroom
Ok. Is the wall wet to the touch or does it have water stains, or is it dry with just spots?
it's dry, just black spots
Thanks. How big is it: smaller than your hand, or bigger than a sheet of paper?
about the size of my hand

Small dry spots usually come from condensation. Wipe them with a mould cleaner or 70% alcohol (gloves, window open), air fully 3-4 times a day for 5-10 minutes, and keep furniture a hand's width from outside walls. Tell me if it comes back.
I cleaned it and aired every day like you said, but it's back and now it's bigger than a sheet of paper
An area that size shouldn't be cleaned yourself, so a mould specialist needs to treat it and check why it grows. Keep the room aired and don't sleep right next to it if you can avoid it.
I'd like to send Trocknungstechnik Aachen over. Is it okay if I share your name, phone number, address and floor with them?
yes
Thanks. Your property manager is confirming the repair, I'll update you shortly.

tell the tenant to clean the large area again
blame the tenant's airing
ask a fourth diagnostic question
